approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reuse the complete terminal-run workflow index to bound one exact RFI or Submittal's primary sources.
Accept only explicit Ball in Court, Priority, Discipline or Location labels in the correct workflow scope.
Keep Ball in Court distinct from Assigned To and inferred responsibility, and keep all four field roles separate.
Apply the same identity, role and complete-value contract to ordinary answers and comparison source findings.
Fail closed on missing fields, conflicts, cross-scope borrowing, Email headers, quoted history, signatures, ordinary prose, vision narration and oversized source sets.
title: Answer and ground exact workflow coordination metadata
objective: Return bounded exact workflow coordination metadata without provider cost and reject unsupported identity, role, value or source-scope borrowing in every answer scope.
